sourceArabicConcepts.غريب: Stranger away from settled ties; not a command to abandon lawful family/livelihood.
sourceArabicConcepts.عابر سبيل: Passing traveller, stronger detachment, light baggage and destination.
sourceArabicConcepts.قصر الأمل: Do not presume lengthy future life; not despair.
sourceArabicConcepts.الزهد: Moderation/detachment, not prohibition of lawful pleasures.
sourceArabicConcepts.خذ من صحتك...ومن حياتك: Use current health/life for deeds before illness/death prevent them.
